title: Software Engineer / AI Code Trainer (Python, Web, Full Stack) at CodeForAI
description_review: Remote AI Code Trainer role evaluating model-generated solutions across algorithms, system design, and web stacks at CodeForAI. pros: Directly values Java, TypeScript, and algorithmic problem-solving capabilities
Applied AI evaluation work touches model code auditing and unit test validation
